definitions.explanation: A narrow opening or space between things.
A brief period of free time between activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隙間|すきま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Wind is coming in through the gap in the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隙間|すきま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put a small box in the gap on the bookshelf.

I read books in my spare moments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{隙間|すきま}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけて→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}する→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy, but I try to find spare moments to exercise.

notes:
{隙間|すきま} refers to a gap, crack, or opening between objects, or figuratively to spare time.

Common collocations:
- {隙間|すきま}⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (draft coming through a gap)
- {隙間|すきま}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (spare time, gaps in one's schedule)
- {隙間|すきま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧ (to fill a gap)
- {隙間|すきま}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧ (niche market/industry)

Related words:
- ⟦{割|わ}れ{目|め}→割れ目：noentry⟧ (crack, fissure)
- ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧ (hole)
